story.title: An invented journey
story.content:
## A letter and two places

This is an invented narrative, written only to exercise the design preview. Eleanor’s dates and relationships are synthetic candidates. The discrepancy between two indexes remains unresolved.

A place name opens a question about daily life, rather than proving a person’s experience. The context report describes the town; it does not establish where Eleanor worked or what she believed.

## What the records suggest

The invented parish entry provides a date candidate. A second synthetic index gives a different day. Both remain visible in the Person workspace until a human compares the original image.

> Remembered family stories belong beside the evidence, with uncertainty visible.

## Questions still open

- Compare the original parish image.
- Review the context report’s sources.
- Keep the draft private while the source conflict remains.

No real family story, personal detail or imported source is used here.
